data.title: Commerce that belongs in EmDash.
data.description: Open-source commerce tools for your EmDash site, with hosted services being built to make setup simpler.

layout.heading: An EmDash foundation
layout.body: Keep your storefront and content in EmDash. DinkusKit is building the catalog, checkout, inventory and payments connections around it.

layout.heading: Inventory, coming soon
layout.body: Hosted Inventory is coming soon and is not required to start with Commerce. You will keep stock in EmDash when that service is ready. An open-source self-host path will be documented; neither path is provisioned on this website today.

layout.heading: Your Stripe account
layout.body: The planned Payments plugin connects your own Stripe account through hosted setup. Customers pay your business through Stripe.

layout.heading: Follow the build
layout.body: You can create a local DinkusKit account on this website. Hosted inventory and payments activation are still being prepared. Explore the source on GitHub and read Getting started for the intended installation experience.

data.title: Your site. One connected experience.
data.description: The first DinkusKit experience is for people who already have an EmDash site.

layout.heading: 1. Create an EmDash site
layout.body: Follow the official EmDash installation guide to scaffold a site with npm create emdash@latest. Official themes are complete Astro templates. This website is not an installer.

layout.heading: 2. Connect your DinkusKit account
layout.body: Sign in with your DinkusKit account. Authorizing a site still requires verified site control from Inventory Connect; this website will not accept a typed site ID. The same account will be able to connect multiple stores once that protocol exists. Hosted onboarding and documented open-source self-hosting are not provisioned here.

layout.heading: 3. Commerce and Template Store
layout.body: Commerce and the Template Store will be released together as a verified pair. Try-the-demo and template setup links will be published here when those destinations exist. No demo or setup destination is available on this site yet.

layout.heading: Trial access
layout.body: Initial hosted Inventory access is planned as a trial without payment details and is not a prerequisite for Commerce. Trial duration, usage limits and pricing have not been set.
